interest: Offers detailed statistical data on postwar Japanese livestock, wartime feed shortages, and occupation dog registration policies.
overview: This file comprises U.S. State Department records from 1946 to 1948 concerning animal husbandry and domestic animals in occupied Japan. It primarily features SCAP Natural Resources Section Report No. 30, which provides extensive prefectural statistics on Japanese livestock populations, slaughter rates, and feed shortages from 1926 to 1946, alongside a cover despatch and distribution schedule. Additionally, the file includes a 1948 diplomatic despatch detailing dog registration procedures and the Japan Shepherd Dog Association.
